auraskills.granite.command.backup.info_b:
Granite /backup (Sprints 60–61, read fabric/SPRINT_61…):
— Perms: auraskills.command.backup = create|save|list|info (default deny). auraskills.command.backup.load = load|restore (default deny).
— create|save: one timestamped .yml under backups/ via BackupProvider (saves online users, then loadStates → UserState snapshot).
— load|restore <file> confirm: two-step; basename only, must stay under backups/; pre-restore automatic backup; then common loadBackup (UserState v1/v2). Not a full config/messages/loot/menus restore.
— list/info: see above.
— Skips: delete, schedules, cloud, SQL dump. Large servers: automatic_backups.max_users can skip pre-backup/backup create.

Sprint 63: /storage save flushes memory → storage. /storage reload explains behavior; for YAML/config/menus/skill data reload use /auraskills reload. Live migration between YAML and SQL is not a command here — set config and restart. Bukkit ref has console-only mergeskills/removeallmodifiers — not ported in S63.

To switch between YAML and SQL, edit config (sql.enabled), then restart the server. Live migration is not available from /storage in Sprint 63.
